releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260907.60+60b05f23"
  - revision: "60b05f23"
  - timestamp: "Mon Sep  7 18:47:41 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #29 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- refactors for sidesign and anisetteKit changes (caching anisette is now taken care by sidesign)
- fix: resign was deadlocked due to coalescer wrapper, moved it inside do catch to always run finalizers
- make port number not have delimiters
- fix: bg task ids in the info.plist wasn't properly was missing fix-up to account for the resigned ids
- fix auth messaging when doing 2FA
- fix sms 2fa challenge in auth
- we don't have available modes so show preferred mode as default and show others too
- fixes for the tunnel config auto discovery for device endpoint (more focused on interested ips + parallel probing for device service port)
- make user friendly by making "repair" and "2fa" handlers throwable
- fix "repair" type response for non-2fa accts
- fix: "repair" type response during GSA wasn't being handled properly and sent to callers
- fix signout flow and refine keychain management with proper ownership in authmanager, certmanager
- fix: do not trigger clearActiveCertificate which internally clears keychain certs too during signout if not desired
- simplify nw path monitoring my reusing minimuxer's nw api pathPublisher
- make tcp probe timeout configurable in developer options
- updated minimuxer to latest (tcpprobe is now configurable) + api changes in gateway
- updated to upstream for lc+ss entitlements processing fixes in SideSign AppBundleSigner.prepare()

#### Full Changelog: [54471d43...60b05f23](https://github.com/The-Big-Mini/MiniStore/compare/54471d436075c51c1a2078c12a8d2fe05ff0c90d...60b05f236fd471e39e120b8992cb7391be110b0a)

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
